scope: Baseline documental calculada nesta revisão; sem retreino ou execução de RF/VQC.
split: Reconstruído do protocolo de train_and_persist.py: classes operacionais em ordem do CSV, rótulos inteiros, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42. Índices históricos não foram fornecidos; identidade exata com a execução antiga não é certificável.

temporal_overlap_maintenance.window_support: [max(0, i-19), i], inclusive; i is the original zero-based CSV data-row index
temporal_overlap_maintenance.scope: Full 3,952-row reconstructed training partition used by RF, before the VQC 400-row subsample; these counts are not asserted for that subsample.
temporal_overlap_maintenance.interpretation: Causal rolling features do not make a random split temporally independent. Test readings contribute to later training windows. This audit does not estimate metric inflation or reproduce historical model predictions.
